title: Central Limit Theorem for a Pólya-Friedman Mixed Urn Model
summary: This paper considers a two-color, single-draw urn model with two types of balls, denoted type $1$ and type $2$, with initial counts $Y^1_0\in N^+$ and $Y^2_0\in N^+$, respectively. At each discrete time step, a ball is drawn uniformly at random, its type observed, and then it is returned to the urn. The urn is subsequently updated according to a mixed replacement matrix: with fixed probability $p\in(0,1)$, the Friedman replacement matrix is applied, adding $a$ balls of the drawn type and $b$ balls of the opposite type; with fixed probability $1-p\in (0,1)$, the Pólya replacement matrix is…
